'''Burning Arrow''' is a [[Bows|bow]] [[attack]] that fires an arrow dealing [[fire damage]] to a target with an increased chance of [[ignite|igniting]] it.

==Skill Functions and Interactions==

==Gem level progression==
{{Skill progression
}}

{{Item acquisition}}

In addition, Burning Arrow is the starting skill gem for [[Ranger]]. It drops after killing the first monster of the game, [[Hungry Corpse]].
{{Skill enchantment modifier list}}
{{Alternate skill effect list|skill=Burning Arrow}}

==Version history==
{{Version history table header}}
{{Version history table row|3.25.0|
* No longer has Added Fire Damage to Attacks against Ignited Enemies at all gem levels.
* It now has 280% Effectiveness of Base and Added Damage at gem level 1 (previously 200%), scaling up to 420% at gem level 20 (previously 300%).
* Now has a Mana cost of 8 at gem level 1 (previously 7), scaling up to 14 at gem level 20 (previously 12).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.23.0|
* Quality now provides 0-20% more Damage with Ignite, instead of 0-20% increased Fire Damage.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.17.0|
* Burning Arrow now deals 200% of base Attack Damage at gem level 1 (previously 150%), up to 300% at gem level 20 (previously 214%). 
* Now has 200% Effectiveness of Added Damage at gem level 1 (previously 150%), up to 300% at gem level 20 (previously 214%). 
* Now has an Attack Speed of 70% of base (previously 90%). 
* Now has a Mana cost of 7 at gem level 1 (previously 5), up to 12 at gem level 20 (previously 8). Now uses the same Bow animation as Puncture.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.16.0|
* No longer has a stacking Burning Effect.
* Now deals 150% base Damage at gem level 1 (unchanged), up to 214% at gem level 20 (previously 184%).
* Now adds 3 to 4 Fire Damage to Attacks against Ignited Enemies at gem level 1, up to 201 to 302 Fire Damage at gem level 20.
* Now has an Attack Speed of 90% of Base (previously 100%).
* Now has a 25% chance to Ignite (previously 50%).
}}
{{Version history table row|3.9.0|
* Now converts 100% of Physical Damage to Fire Damage (from 50%).
* Now has 50% chance to Ignite Enemies at all gem levels (previously 30% at gem level 1, up to 49% at gem level 20).
* Now deals 50% more damage with Ignite at gem level 1 (from 30%), up to 88% at gem level 20 (From 68%).
* Now applies an additional debuff when you Ignite, dealing extra burning damage based on the magnitude of the Ignite.
* Now gains +1% to Fire Damage over Time Multiplier per 2% gem quality (from 3% increased Ignite duration per 1% gem quality).
* Burning Arrow's threshold jewels, {{il|Pitch Darkness}} and {{il|Sudden Ignition}}, no longer drops and cannot be obtained outside of trading with other players.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.3.0|
* Now has 30% chance to ignite at gem level 1, up to 49% at gem level 20 (up from 20% at all levels)
* Now deals 30% more damage with ignite at gem level 1, up to 68% more damage with ignite at gem level 20.
* No longer has increased burning damage.
}}
{{Version history table row|3.1.0|
* The amount of burning damage dealt by the burning ground created by a Burning Arrow on a character with the {{il|Pitch Darkness}} threshold jewel is now determined by the level of the Burning Arrow skill gem.
}}
{{Version history table row|2.1.0|
* Burning Arrow's base damage has been increased from 130% to 150% at level 1 and 160.4% to 184.2% at level 20.
}}
{{Version history table row|1.2.0|
* Burning Arrow: This skill now deals 130% of base damage, has 50% converted to fire, and has a fixed ignite chance. It gains increased burning damage and physical damage per level.
}}
{{Version history table row|1.1.0|
* The ignite chance on levels over 20 continues to progress linearly, rather than slowing the progression as it previously did. 
}}
{{Version history table row|0.10.0|
* Burning Arrow is now properly affected by the Point Blank keystone passive and the Chin Sol unique item.
}}
{{Version history table row|0.9.9|
* Increased mana cost at higher levels.
}}
{{Version history table row|0.9.7|
* Burning Arrow has been added to the game.
}}
{{Version history table end}}
